title: Assassin Case Gets Rehearing - Princile Suspect, Out On Bail, Absent From Court

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Friday, June 25, 1937

Assassin Case
Gets Rehearing

Principle Suspect, Out
On Bail, Absent
From Court

The case of the assassination of Mr. Tang Chai-bang, former manager of the Great World Amusement Resort, in 1933, which has been dragging on for the past four years, was brought up for investigation in the 3rd Kiangsu High Court this morning. The principal in the case, Wang Hsing-kao, suspected of having taken a hand in the murder, who was granted bail of $20,000 during his trial last year, failed to appear in court today and today's session was featured by the questioning of a witness, Mr. Sun King-liang, manager of the Asia Hotel on Avenue Edward VII.

The protracted case had its beginning in the winter of 1934 when Wang Hsing-kao was arrested in connection with the murder. He was duly tried in the Second Special District Court and was given a life term. Later in the same year Mr. Koc Chu-hsiao, owner of the Tien Shuan Theatre, was convicted by the same court and given 15 years for alleged instigation of the crime. Both filed appeal in the 3rd Kiangsu High Court and on June 6 of last year they were found not guilty by the high court and released on bail of $20,000 for Wang and $27,000 for Koo.

With the dismissal of the case by the high court the French Municipal Police filed an appeal with the Supreme Court in Nanking, and after months of protracted investigation the Supreme Court ordered the local high court to re-open the case against Wang Hsing-kao. In the meantime, the case against Koo is being investigated by the Nanking Supreme Court. Hearings in the case were postponed sine die as Wang Hsing-kao is reported not to be in Shanghai.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1937年6月25日，星期五

刺客案
获重审

主要嫌疑人
保释在外
缺席庭审

1933年前“大世界”游乐场经理唐嘉鹏（Tang Chai-bang）遇刺案，过去四年一直拖延未决，今晨在江苏高等法院第三分院开庭调查。本案主要嫌疑人王兴高（Wang Hsing-kao），涉嫌参与谋杀，去年审判期间获准以2万美元保释，今日未出庭。今日的庭审主要特征是讯问了一位证人，即爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）亚洲酒店经理孙景良（Sun King-liang，音译）先生。

这起旷日持久的案件始于1934年冬，当时王兴高因涉及谋杀案被捕。他在第二特区地方法院接受正式审判，并被判处无期徒刑。同年晚些时候，“天蟾舞台”老板柯竹轩（Koc Chu-hsiao，即顾竹轩）被同一法院定罪，因涉嫌教唆犯罪而被判处15年徒刑。两人均向江苏高等法院第三分院提出上诉，去年6月6日，高等法院宣判两人无罪，并准予保释，王兴高保释金为2万美元，柯竹轩为2.7万美元。

随着高等法院驳回此案，法租界公董局警务处向南京最高法院提出上诉。经过数月的漫长调查，最高法院命令当地高等法院重新审理针对王兴高的案件。与此同时，南京最高法院正在调查针对柯竹轩的案件。由于据报道王兴高不在上海，该案的听证会被无限期推迟。

March 5, 1937, Afternoon Translation.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE CASE OF KOO TSOH SHIEN

In Autumn, 1935, Koo Tsoh Shien ( 顧竹軒 ), proprietor of the Tien Zay Wu Tan Theatre ( 天蟾舞臺 ), was arrested by the French Police on a charge of having instigated the murder of Tang Chia Bang ( 唐嘉鵬 ), and was sentenced to 15 years' imprisonment by the 2nd Special District Court. He appealed and in the summer of 1936, the Third Branch of the Kiangsu High Court found Koo not guilty.

The French Police appealed to the Supreme Court. During the period of appeal, Koo Tsoh Shien served a sentence in the 2nd Special District Gaol for opium smoking. His term of imprisonment expired on December 12, 1936.

On December 17, 1936, the Third Branch of the Kiangsu High Court released Koo Tsoh Shien on shop security of $10,000 and cash security of $7,000. Opposing the release of Koo on bail, the French Police requested the Third Branch of the Kiangsu High Court to submit a protest to the Supreme Court on its behalf.

It is now learned that the Supreme Court has dismissed the protest submitted by the French Police for the release of Koo Tsoh Shien on bail.

The appeal filed by the French Police against the dismissal of the charge against Koo Tso Shien of having instigated a murder will be heard by the Supreme Court.

1937年3月5日，下午译文。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

顾竹轩案

1935年秋，天蟾舞臺老板顾竹轩（Koo Tsoh Shien）被法租界巡捕房逮捕，罪名是教唆谋杀唐嘉鵬（Tang Chia Bang），并被第二特区地方法院判处15年监禁。他提出上诉，1936年夏，江苏高等法院第三分院宣判顾竹轩无罪。

法租界巡捕房向最高法院提出上诉。在上诉期间，顾竹轩因吸食鸦片在第二特区监狱服刑。他的刑期于1936年12月12日届满。

1936年12月17日，江苏高等法院第三分院准许顾竹轩以店铺担保1万美元和现金担保7千美元保释。法租界巡捕房反对顾竹轩保释，请求江苏高等法院第三分院代表其向最高法院提出抗议。

现获悉，最高法院已驳回法租界巡捕房就顾竹轩保释一事提出的抗议。

最高法院将审理法租界巡捕房就撤销顾竹轩教唆谋杀指控一事提出的上诉。

December 18, 1936.
Afternoon Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

MEETING OF CHINESE RATEPAYERS OF FRENCH CONCESSION

100 representatives of Chinese ratepayers in the French Concession held a meeting in the Chung Wei Bank Building, Avenue Edward VII, French Concession, at 2 p.m. yesterday. Amongst those present were Messrs. Tu Yueh Sen (杜月笙), Loh Pah Hung (陸伯鴻) and Zien Sin Ts (錢新之).
The following resolutions were discussed and passed:-
1) That owing to the general depression in the French Concession, the expenditure of the French Municipal Council for the year 1937 be cut down.
2) That with regard to the action of General Chang Hsueh Liang in holding up Generalissimo Chiang Kai Shek and leading his troops against the Government, a telegram of reproach be despatched to General Chang Hsueh Liang urging him to come to his senses.
An election of Chinese members and committeemen to the French Municipal Council then took place, as a result of which Messrs. Loh Pah Hung, Zien Sin Ts, Chang Siao Ling (張林), Chang Chi Si (張先) and Zi Yuin Tsin (齊云青) were elected Chinese members on the Council whilst Messrs. Chang Fah Yao (張發堯), King Ting Sen (金廷), Wu Kai Sen (吳凱聲), Chen Teh Chwang (陳德彰), King Lih Jen (金立人), Tong Kuh Chong (董克昌), Zang Mou Chiang (臧慕姜), Chuin Zing Yen (秦靜巖) and Chu Shing Niang (祝興讓) were appointed as committeemen.

Lih Pao and other local newspapers:

KOO TSO SHIEN RELEASED

Koo Tso Shien (顧竹軒), the former proprietor of the Tien Zay Wu Tan Theatre (天蟾舞臺), who was arrested by the French Police on suspicion of having instigated the murder of Mr. Tong Chia Pang (唐家鵬), ex-manager of the Great World Amusement Resort, was released at 3.45 p.m. yesterday by order of the 3rd Branch of the Kiangsu High Court after his family had furnished cash security of $7,000 and shop security of $10,000.
Koo Tso Shien has been under detention for 15 months and 8 days.

Society Evening News (社會晚報) dated Dec.17:

PAPER HUNTING

The Shanghai Paper Hunt Club conducts paper hunts every winter. Last Saturday a hunt was conducted in Zau Wu Ching and heavy damage was caused to the crops. As another race will take place this Saturday, and as the authorities are not taking any action to prevent it, the farmers have planted bamboo sticks fastened with either ropes or wire along the routes to be taken by the paper hunts.

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

法租界华人纳税人的会议

昨日下午2时，法租界100名华人纳税人代表在法租界爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的中汇银行大楼举行会议。出席者包括杜月笙（Tu Yueh Sen）、陆伯鸿（Loh Pah Hung）和钱新之（Zien Sin Ts）等先生。
会议讨论并通过了以下决议：
1) 鉴于法租界普遍萧条，削减法公董局1937年度的支出。
2) 关于张学良将军扣押蒋介石总司令并率兵对抗政府的行为，向张学良将军发出谴责电报，促其醒悟。
随后进行了法公董局华董及委员的选举，结果陆伯鸿、钱新之、张林（Chang Siao Ling）、张先（Chang Chi Si）和齐云青（Zi Yuin Tsin）当选为公董局华董，而张发堯（Chang Fah Yao）、金廷（King Ting Sen）、吴凯声（Wu Kai Sen）、陈德彰（Chen Teh Chwang）、金立人（King Lih Jen）、董克昌（Tong Kuh Chong）、臧慕姜（Zang Mou Chiang）、秦静巖（Chuin Zing Yen）和祝興讓（Chu Shing Niang）被任命为委员。

《立报》及其他本地报纸：

顾竹轩获释

前“大世界”游乐场经理唐嘉鵬（Tong Chia Pang，音译）遇刺案嫌疑人、天蟾舞臺前老板顾竹轩（Koo Tso Shien），曾被法租界巡捕房逮捕，涉嫌教唆谋杀。在其家属提供7千美元现金担保和1万美元店铺担保后，根据江苏高等法院第三分院的命令，他于昨日下午3时45分获释。
顾竹轩已被拘留15个月零8天。

12月17日《社会晚报》：

猎纸游戏

上海猎纸俱乐部每年冬季都举行猎纸游戏。上周六在曹家渡（Zau Wu Ching，音译）举行了一次狩猎活动，对农作物造成了严重破坏。由于本周六还将进行另一场比赛，且当局未采取任何措施予以阻止，农民们在猎纸路线沿途种植了用绳子或铁丝固定的竹竿。

December 10, 1936.
Afternoon Translation.
Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:
KOO TSO SHIEN TO BE RELEASED ON SECURITY
The appeal for release from detention filed by
Koo Tso Shien (顧竹軒 ) was heard by Presiding Judge Wu Ting
Chi (吳廷琪 ) and Judges Liao Yen (廖 ) and Wong Yueh (王 )
in the Third Branch of the Kiangsu High Court at 2.45 p.m.
yesterday.
Addressing Koo Tso Shien, the Court said: "The
case against you for instigating murder has not yet been
settled. You must furnish suitable security for your
release."
Koo Tso Shien made the following reply: "Ever
since my arrest, all the concerns managed by me have gone
into bankruptcy. I am not in a position to offer cash
security but I can furnish reliable shop security. As I
have been doing business for some 30 years in Shanghai and
have never left Shanghai, there need be no fear of my
escaping."
The Court then ordered Koo Tso Shien to furnish
$10,000 cash security and $10,000 shop security for his
release. At the repeated requests of Koo Tso Shien and
his lawyer, the Court finally reduced the amounts to $7,000
cash and a written shop security of $10,000 guaranteeing his
appearance in Court whenever summoned.
It is understood that the family of Koo Tso Shien
is arranging for this security and he will probably be
released to-day.
The Sin-Zing-Zuh (新認識 'New Knowledge'), Vol.6, published
the following article contributed by one Hsiao Dien (蕭田 ):
REACTION TO HUMILIATION
I recount hereunder what really happened at Tazang
as certain facts have been misrepresented in newspaper reports.
Since the January 28 Incident, XX ronins have
frequently visited the vicinity of Tazang in large numbers
on Sundays, arriving at 6 o'clock in the morning and not
returning until evening. They come either to fish or to
shoot birds. They often trample down the fences. Thus
they had already incurred the hostility of the farmers.
At about 4 p.m. October 25, six subjects of the
so-called "civilized friendly nation" were preparing to leave
after having completed their outing. As they passed Yue
Ching Jao (餘慶橋), they, for the third time, tore down a
caricature posted on a wall near the place. They did it in
a manner challenging to the people. Their action let loose
the anger which had been smouldering in the breasts of the
people. Quickly a number of inhabitants assembled and
clenching their fists they shouted angrily:
"Rape your mother ( 操你格娘格屁 ).
"Kill the tortoises!"
"Kill the XX devils!"
"Kill the XX pigs!"
"Overthrow the XX tortoises!"
The Peace Preservation Corps and the Bureau of Publi:
Safety were informed and officials were later detailed to
escort the six XX subjects out of the district.

1936年12月10日。
下午译文。
《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：
顾竹轩将凭保获释

顾竹轩（Koo Tso Shien）提出的解除拘留上诉，于昨日下午2时45分在江苏高等法院第三分院由审判长吴廷琪（Wu Ting Chi）以及法官廖某（Liao Yen，原文缺字）和王某（Wong Yueh，原文缺字）审理。
法庭对顾竹轩说：“你涉嫌教唆谋杀的案件尚未结案。你必须提供适当的担保才能获释。”
顾竹轩回答如下：“自从我被捕以来，我经营的所有商号均已破产。我无法提供现金担保，但我可以提供可靠的店铺担保。我在上海经商约30年，从未离开过上海，因此不必担心我会逃跑。”
法庭随即命令顾竹轩提供1万美元现金担保和1万美元店铺担保以获释。经顾竹轩及其律师反复请求，法庭最终将金额减至7千美元现金和1万美元书面店铺担保，保证他随传随到。
据悉，顾竹轩的家人正在安排此项担保，他可能于今日获释。

第六卷《新认识》（Sin-Zing-Zuh）刊登了一篇由萧田（Hsiao Dien）撰写的文章：
对屈辱的反应
鉴于报纸报道中某些事实被歪曲，我在此叙述在大场（Tazang，音译）实际发生的情况。
自“一·二八”事变以来，XX浪人经常在周日大批涌向大场附近，早上6点到达，直到晚上才返回。他们要么来钓鱼，要么来打鸟。他们经常践踏篱笆。因此，他们已经引起了农民的敌意。
10月25日下午4点左右，六名所谓“文明友邦”的臣民在完成郊游后准备离开。当他们经过余庆桥（Yue Ching Jao，音译）时，第三次撕下了贴在附近墙上的讽刺漫画。他们的做法带有挑衅民众的意味。这一举动释放了人们心中积压的怒火。很快，许多居民聚集起来，握紧拳头愤怒地喊道：
“操你格娘格屁。”
“杀乌龟！”
“杀XX鬼子！”
“杀XX猪！”
“打倒XX乌龟！”
保卫团和公安局接到通知，随后派遣官员护送这六名XX臣民离开该地区。

March 1, 1936.    Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers (29/2) :-

ALLEGED BRIBERY BY KOO TSO SHIEN.

During the hearing of the appeal filed by
Koo Tso Shien against his sentence of 15 years imprisonment
on a charge of instigating the murder of Tang Kia Bang, Tsang
Ding Kwei(張廷桂), one of the culprits concerned in the
murder, accused Koo Tso Shien with having bribed certain
warders to instigate him to retract his statement. Consequently
the Kiangsu Third Branch High Court adjourned the hearing of
the appeal and instructed the Procuratorate of the Shanghai
Second Special District Court to conduct an inquiry into the
new charge against Koo Tso Shien.
On February 26, the Procuratorate of the
Shanghai Second Special District Court, having concluded its
enquiry, instituted formal proceedings in the Criminal Division
of the same Court against Koo Tso Shien, his brother Koo Soong
Low(顧松茂) and several warders, three of whom have already
absconded.
In connection with another accusation brought
by Lee Woo Zang(李和尚) and other prisoners against Koo
Tso Shien for smoking opium in the St. Marie Hospital and
against Chia Foh Yoong(賈福榮), head gaoler of the
Shanghai Second Special District Gaol, and Woo Loo(吳魯),
head warder of the Detention House, for shielding the offence
and neglect of duty, Procurator Wong Ning(王任) of Shanghai
Second Special District Court held an investigation at 11 a.m.
yesterday.
Chia Foh Yoong, age 42, native of Soh Shien
(宿遷), was first examined.
Questioned by the Procurator as to whether
he had made a duplicate key to a small room of the prison
ward by means of soap and whether he had allowed Koo Tso
Shien to smoke opium, Chia strongly denied the charge and
stated that in order to prevent a further attempt at escape
by one of the prisoners named Wong Ah Nyl(王阿二) he locked
the door of the small room, the key to which was taken away
by a nurse. He added that he never saw Koo Tso Shien smoking
opium.
Koh Shuan Yue(郭善餘), one of the prisoners
who made the complaint, testified that Koo Tso Shien had
smoked opium and that Chia Foh Yoong was fully aware of this.

1936年3月1日。    上午译文。

《申报》及其他本地报纸（2月29日）：

顾竹轩涉嫌行贿。

在审理顾竹轩就教唆谋杀唐嘉邦（Tang Kia Bang）一案被判15年监禁提出的上诉期间，与该谋杀案有关的罪犯之一张廷桂（Tsang Ding Kwei）指控顾竹轩贿赂某些狱卒，唆使其撤回供词。因此，江苏高等法院第三分院休庭，并指示上海第二特区地方法院检察处对针对顾竹轩的新指控进行调查。
2月26日，上海第二特区地方法院检察处结束调查，在同一法院刑事庭对顾竹轩、其弟顾松茂（Koo Soong Low）以及几名狱卒正式提起诉讼，其中三名狱卒已潜逃。
关于李和尚（Lee Woo Zang）和其他囚犯对顾竹轩在圣玛丽医院（St. Marie Hospital）吸食鸦片，以及上海第二特区监狱典狱长贾福荣（Chia Foh Yoong）和拘留所主管狱卒吴鲁（Woo Loo）包庇罪行和玩忽职守的另一项指控，上海第二特区地方法院检察官王任（Wong Ning）于昨日上午11时进行了调查。
首先受审的是贾福荣，42岁，宿迁（Soh Shien）人。
检察官询问他是否用肥皂制作了监狱病房小房间的备用钥匙，以及是否允许顾竹轩吸食鸦片，贾强烈否认指控，并称为了防止一名叫王阿二（Wong Ah Nyl）的囚犯再次试图逃跑，他锁上了小房间的门，钥匙被一名护士拿走。他补充说，他从未见过顾竹轩吸食鸦片。
投诉人之一的囚犯郭善餘（Koh Shuan Yue）作证说，顾竹轩曾吸食鸦片，且贾福荣完全知情。他说，囚犯刘明镜（Liu Ming Ching）和李和尚（Lee Woo Zang）可以佐证他的证词。
吴鲁（Woo Loo），41岁，扬州人，拘留所主管狱卒，称他没有看到顾竹轩吸食鸦片，直到上海第二特区监狱第二科科长发现香烟和鸦片后，他才得知此事。
另一名囚犯陈国芳（Zung Kuo Faung），别名白渡轩（Bah Doo Jan，音译），25岁，绍兴人，否认知晓顾竹轩吸食鸦片或贾福荣等人包庇他的事实。

THE KOO TSO SHIEN CASE

Koo Tso Shien (顧竹軒), formerly the proprietor of the Tien Zay Wu Tan Theatre (天蟾舞台), was sentenced to 15 years' imprisonment by the 2nd Shanghai Special District Court on a charge of having instigated the murder of Tang Kia Bang (唐嘉鵬), manager of the Great World Amusement Resort. The Captain's Office of the Membership Canvassing Groups of the China National Aviation Corporation summoned a number of hot water shop owners and held a meeting with them on February 8 to discuss the collection of aviation contributions from their shops.

天蟾舞台老板顾竹轩，是一名青帮“大汉”（big loafer，指流氓头目），于1933年6月18日，唆使王兴高、周二（木匠）、赵广福和张廷桂刺杀已故大世界游乐场经理唐嘉鹏。
谋杀发生后，赵和张因顾竹轩未按承诺付款，拒绝归还顾给他们的枪支。随后，他们因顾竹轩泄露的消息被法租界巡捕房逮捕。经查，他们持有的枪支曾被用于刺杀唐嘉鹏；因此，这些人被判处监禁。
当赵和张被法租界巡捕房逮捕时，顾竹轩花费了大量金钱，并请托其亲戚之一、法租界巡捕房探长金九林设法在此案中包庇他。结果，在案件调查期间，每当赵和张提到顾竹轩的名字时，就会遭到法租界巡捕的严厉殴打。

After three hearings, Zau and Tsang were

Subsequently, they filed a complaint against Wong

Koo, after having been arrested, claimed
to be suffering from mental disorders and was
sent to the St. Marie Hospital.

In the hospital he was permitted to
receive friends and relations freely, therefore,
he was not restricted and could discuss with
others statements to be made before Court, ways
of destroying evidence and means of buying over
witnesses, with a view to evading responsibility
of the crime.

Koo Tso Shien has been smoking opium for
more than ten years and has acquired the habit.
This is known to all. However, since he was
arrested, we have not heard that the hospital
has made any report on his opium habit. Although
Koo said that he was sick when attending the
Court for trial, yet he did not appear to be
in a depressed state or to desire to satisfy
his craving for opium. Persons attending the
hearing were much surprised at this. They did
not know that at a fixed time every day, members
of Koo's family brought opium for Koo to smoke.

顾竹轩请求律师朱殿卿去监狱探望他们，并向他们承诺，只要他们不披露是他唆使谋杀的事实，他（顾）将努力营救他们。

经过三次审讯，赵和张最终被判处监禁。见获释无望，且顾竹轩未按承诺支付一万美元，赵和张意识到自己受骗了。随后，他们对王兴高和顾竹轩提出控告。

顾竹轩被捕后，声称患有精神疾病，并被送往圣玛丽医院。

在医院里，他被允许自由会见亲友，因此未受限制，并能与他人讨论在法庭上的供词、销毁证据的方法以及收买证人的手段，以图逃避罪责。

众所周知，顾竹轩吸食鸦片已有十余年，并已养成习惯。然而，自从他被捕以来，我们未听说医院对其鸦片瘾有任何报告。虽然顾竹轩在出庭受审时称病，但他并未表现出情绪低落或渴望满足鸦片瘾的样子。出席听证的人对此大为惊讶。他们不知道的是，每天在固定时间，顾竹轩的家人都会带鸦片来给他吸食。

(3)

On September 27, when the case was being heard, an uproar
took place in the street to which prisoners in the detention house
responded. The Chief of the Criminal Division became afraid and
ran away. Lawyers and witnesses laid their faces down on the
tables and the people in Court were petrified with fear. Knowing
Koo's followers to be legion, the French Police had detailed some
160 detectives beforehand to sit in the Court, in case of any
emergency. Why did the French Police make such extensive
precautions if Koo Tso Shien is a good man? The detectives
then drew their pistols. Upon hearing of the trouble, the
French Police immediately delegated a party of armed policemen
to surround the Court and precautionary measures were adopted.
The situation by this time had reached a climax unprecedented in
the history of the Court. Disorder prevailed but fortunately
there were no casualties.

The Court has received innumerable anonymous threatening
letters since it handled the case. The Chief of the Criminal
Division, Wong, who is hearing the case is so far known as pure
and upright. The residents were very glad and thought that
they would be well rid of a wicked devil who commits murder.
Nevertheless, a rumour prevails among the community that the
Chief of the Criminal Division, under a certain pretext, did
not attend the Court and asked for leave two days before the
date of judgment, because he had already been threatened by
Koo Tso Shien. We also became afraid when we heard this.

Since the opening of the trial, the accused Koo has
selected some eight persons to be his witnesses for the purpose
of making statements beneficial to him. All these statements
are contradictory and false. The witnesses are all natives
of Kompo and are Koo's fellow countrymen; they are former
gaol birds, having committed murder, robbery, kidnapping and
other serious offences. It is clear that they are Koo's

(3)

9月27日，本案开庭审理期间，街头发生骚乱，拘留所内的囚犯亦随之响应。刑事科科长心生恐惧，仓皇逃离。律师与证人纷纷伏案躲避，法庭内众人惊恐万状。法租界警方深知顾竹轩（Koo Tso Shien）党羽众多，事先已部署约160名侦探坐镇法庭，以防突发紧急状况。若顾竹轩确为良善之辈，法租界警方何须采取如此周密的防范措施？随后，侦探们拔出手枪。获悉骚乱情况后，法租界警方立即派遣一队武装警察包围法庭，并采取预防性措施。此时局势已达法庭历史上前所未有的紧张顶点。现场虽一片混乱，但幸未造成人员伤亡。

自受理此案以来，法庭收到无数匿名恐吓信。负责审理此案的刑事科科长王（Wong）迄今以清廉正直著称。市民对此深感欣慰，认为即将铲除一个犯下谋杀罪行的恶棍。然而，社会上流传着一种谣言，称刑事科科长因受顾竹轩威胁，借故未出庭，并在判决日前两天请假。我们闻听此事，亦感到恐惧。

自审判开始以来，被告顾某挑选了约八人作为其证人，旨在作出对其有利的陈述。所有这些陈述均相互矛盾且虚假不实。这些证人均为江浦（Kompo，音译）籍贯，是顾某的同乡；他们曾是惯犯，犯有谋杀、抢劫、绑架及其他严重罪行。显然，他们是顾某的

page_data.en:
(4)

satalites and they only acted in accordance with Koo's wishes.
Although Koo is confined in hospital, he can communicate with
prisoners in gaol. From this, we can see how great Koo's
influence is.

Koo Tso Shien was formerly a loafer. In the
9th, 10th and 11th year of the Chinese Republic, he was
repeatedly convicted and sentenced to terms of imprisonment
for offences of pocket-picking, receiving stolen property
and causing bodily harm to others. Later he assembled a
large number of followers and thus became influential. Later
he engaged himself in social enterprises in order to place
himself in the same rank as other prominent persons as a
camouflage for his unlawful activities. He used to
instruct his followers to rob mercantile steamers in the
vicinity of Kompo and by means of threats, forced the Dah
Sun(大生) Steamship Company to come under his control.
In addition, he threatened by violence the old shareholders
of the Tien Zuen Wu Dai Theatre into surrendering their shares
to him. He often instigated his followers to murder
persons whom he considered to be his enemies or with whom
he came into conflict on the questions of power or money.
About five or six persons, such as Zang Tahung Heng(常春恆),
an actor, Zung Yung Sung(陳永生), former manager of the Dah
Wu Dai Theatre, and Daung Kia Bang, have so far fallen
victims. Other cases of intimidation, fraud, robbery
and kidnapping of which he is guilty are innumerable.

The bogus organization which was in existence
during the January 28 Incident was in reality founded under
the directions of Koo Tso Shien. Hu Lieh Foo(胡立夫),
Zang Ngoh Tsing(常玉清) and others simply played their
parts nominally. However, due to his low cunning, Koo
stood aloof from the law in spite of the fact that Hu Lieh
Foo had been executed and Zang Ngoh Tsing had fled. This
was because Koo was able to utilize his position to mislead
page_data.zh:
(4)

爪牙，仅按顾某的意愿行事。尽管顾某被羁押于医院，他仍能与监狱中的囚犯联络。由此可见顾某影响力之大。

顾竹轩昔日曾是无业游民。在民国九年、十年及十一年间，他因扒窃、收受赃物及伤害他人身体等罪行，多次被判刑入狱。后来，他纠集大量追随者，从而变得颇具势力。此后，他投身社会事业，以此作为掩护其非法活动的幌子，试图跻身于其他知名人士之列。他曾指使手下在江浦（Kompo，音译）附近抢劫商船，并通过威胁手段，迫使大生轮船公司受其控制。此外，他还以暴力威胁天蟾舞台（Tien Zuen Wu Dai Theatre，音译）的老股东，迫使其将股份转让给他。他经常煽动手下谋杀那些他视为敌人或在权力与金钱问题上与其发生冲突的人。截至目前，已有约五六人成为受害者，包括演员常春恆（Zang Tahung Heng，音译）、大舞台（Dah Wu Dai Theatre，音译）前经理陈永生（Zung Yung Sung，音译）以及Daung Kia Bang（音译）。他所犯下的恐吓、诈骗、抢劫和绑架案件更是数不胜数。

在一·二八事变期间存在的那个伪组织，实际上是在顾竹轩的指示下成立的。胡立夫（Hu Lieh Foo）、常玉清（Zang Ngoh Tsing）等人 merely 挂名扮演角色。然而，顾竹轩凭借狡诈手段，尽管胡立夫已被处决、常玉清潜逃，他本人却得以逍遥法外。这是因为顾竹轩能够利用其地位误导

page_data.en:
- 5 -
the public.
Ma Goh Zung (馬工〔此处转录不清〕) was originally a remnant
of the militarists, and had revolted against the Govern-
ment for a number of years. As a result of a drastic
suppressive campaign conducted by Gen. Chiang Kai Shek,
he suffered defeat and came to Shanghai for shelter.
However, there was still a certain number of Ma's men
who, ever anxious to revive their activities, sided with
Koo Tso Shien. There are many of these unlawful elements
to be found among Koo's sworn confederates. At Koo's
instigation these evil-doers committed robbery, abduction
and armed kidnapping, and the crimes were well organized.
After the commission of a crime, a fixed amount of money
was given to the family of the evil-doer, and travelling
expenses were issued to him to enable him to escape.
The booty thus obtained was divided in certain proportions.
Koo also entered into alliance with the Chapei
Merchant Volunteer Corps and the volunteer units in various
Hsiens in Kompo. In the case of crimes committed by his
followers, while the authorities were hot on their trails,
those who committed the offence in Kompo came to hide
among the Merchant Volunteer Corps in Shanghai, whereas
those who did the evil in Shanghai fled to Kompo and
remained low among the volunteer units there. As regards
the firearms used in the commission of these crimes,
members of the Chapei Volunteer Corps in uniform were
held responsible for their transportation, and consequently
it was difficult for the police authorities, well-organized
as they are, to detect this traffic. This was how the
loafers of Kompo all came under his influence. How
then can the peace and order of the district be maintained?
page_data.zh:
- 5 -
公众。
马工〔此处转录不清〕（Ma Goh Zung，音译）原为军阀残余势力，曾反叛政府多年。由于蒋介石将军开展严厉的镇压行动，他战败后逃至上海寻求庇护。然而，马氏部下中仍有不少人渴望重振活动，转而依附顾竹轩。在顾竹轩的结拜兄弟中，此类不法之徒比比皆是。在顾竹轩的唆使下，这些恶徒实施抢劫、绑架及武装劫持，犯罪行为组织严密。作案后，会向恶徒家属支付固定金额，并发放旅费助其潜逃。所得赃物按一定比例分配。顾竹轩还与闸北商人义勇队及江浦（Kompo，音译）各县的义勇单位结成联盟。在其手下作案时，若当局紧追不舍，在江浦作案者便躲入上海的商人义勇队中，而在上海作案者则逃往江浦，潜伏于当地的义勇单位中。至于作案使用的枪支，由身着制服的闸北义勇队成员负责运输，因此，尽管警察当局组织严密，也难以察觉这种非法交易。江浦的无业游民 thus 全部受其影响。如此一来，该地区的治安秩序又如何能得以维持？

page_data.en:
- 6 -

After all, there will be no peace in Shanghai
or in Kompo unless Koo is removed. The public is
earnestly requested to uphold justice and it is hoped
that the Judicial Authorities will detail an honest
and high official to conduct careful enquiries into
this case.

Koo is very influential and as the Court
in Shanghai now handling the case has been intimidated,
as above-mentioned, it is feared that this Court cannot
deal with the case justly. We, therefore, disclose
the opinions of the public regarding the case in the hope
that the $120,000 with which Koo bribed the Court and the
$30,000 with which he bribed the Police, through the
Police Advocate Fee Zih Tsung (費席珍), will fail to
effect Koo's release.
page_data.zh:
- 6 -

总之，若不除掉顾竹轩，上海或江浦（Kompo，音译）皆无安宁可言。恳请公众主持正义，并希望司法当局委派一位廉洁高尚的官员对此案进行细致调查。

顾竹轩势力庞大，鉴于目前在上海审理此案的法庭如上所述已受到恐吓，恐怕该法庭无法公正处理此案。因此，我们披露公众对此案的看法，希望顾竹轩通过警务督察费席珍（Fee Zih Tsung，音译）贿赂法庭的12万美元及贿赂警方的3万美元，不能达到使其获释的目的。
